regime.skew: call-rich at 25d (-1.31), put-rich in the 10d tail (+1.66)
regime.label: Dealer short-gamma with no flip anywhere in the strip; protection thickening in the 960 tail while the near-money downside bid fades
evidence: -771 is the cumulative net GEX at 1,150, the top of the strip, and the running sum never turns positive anywhere from 960 upward - it troughs at -4,472 at the 1,040 strike, directly under spot 1,052.3. The 1,050 strike is only where per-strike call gamma starts to outweigh put gamma (+324 net); it is not a true flip, so there is no stabilising shelf above the money.

+535 contracts of OI today (7,639 call / 8,233 put, 15,872 total) and +7,440 since 2026-09-30 - an 88% build in five sessions. OI expanding this fast rules out Unwind and fits a young 83-DTE back quarter still drawing its risk map.

+162 OI on 272 lots at the 960 put - the largest OI add of the session, at the largest single strike on the board (1,654 OI) - keeps thickening the structural floor 92 points below spot, matched by a +1.66 ten-delta tail skew (970 put IV 14.35% vs 1,120 call IV 12.69%).

-1.31 at the 25-delta (1,010 put 11.30% vs 1,080 call 12.61%) is call-rich and widened from -0.82, while the 1,000 put - yesterday's near wall - shed -19 OI on 79 lots. Vol2Vol fails at the money: volume without an OI build and with flat IV means that downside bid is no longer being paid for.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1,052.3 on the Dec future is +2.8 today and 2.3 points above max pain 1,050, but the pain curve is shallow - 659,440 at 1,050 against 665,490 at 1,040 and 666,090 at 1,060, a 1% bowl spanning 20 points - so the anchor exerts almost no pull. Cumulative net dealer GEX is negative at every strike from 960 to 1,150, troughing at -4,472 under the money at 1,040 and still -771 at the top of the strip: there is no gamma flip to lean on, and dealers amplify in both directions. Put/call volume ran 1.55 (1,322 vs 853 lots), the most put-led session of the window, yet put OI added only +282 - 79% of that flow was two-way, so it is churn rather than fresh insurance. 11.45% ATM IV broke a three-session compression (+0.27) and prices a 7.59-point daily move, leaving the 1,100 call wall 47.7 points away - 6.3 daily sigma.
what_changed: Put/call volume ratio jumped 1.13 -> 1.55, the most put-led session of the eight-session window, but 1,322 put lots produced only +282 put OI (21% conversion) - the put tape was closing and rolling, not buying new protection.
ATM IV ticked 11.18% -> 11.45% (+0.27), ending a three-session compression; 11.45% is exactly the eight-session mean, so the cheap-vol window that opened on 2026-10-06 is closing.

Call OI extended up the strip - +65 at 1,060, +64 at 1,090, +71 at 1,150 on 300 combined lots - while the 1,100 wall itself added only +12 on 96 lots; the ceiling is being drawn above the wall rather than at it.
Net total GEX repaired -885 -> -771, a sixth straight session of healing from the -2,605 of 2026-10-01, but the cumulative sum is still negative at every one of the 20 listed strikes.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: Net total GEX went -188 on 2026-09-30 to -2,605 on 2026-10-01 as the Dec future gapped 1,069.1 -> 1,041.9 (-27.2), and six sessions of repair have brought it only to -771 - the dealer short-gamma regime that began five sessions ago is still fully intact, never having crossed back positive. Open interest nearly doubled through it, 8,432 -> 15,872 contracts (+7,440, +88%), with the heaviest five-day builds at the 1,050 call (+658), the 1,100 call (+635) and the 960 put (+972): a 960-1,100 corridor drawn, not a direction defended. Price has recovered +11.1 points off the 2026-10-01 low to 1,052.3 but is still -16.8 below 2026-09-30, and max pain walked down to meet it - 1,070 -> 1,060 -> 1,050 - where it has now sat two sessions, spot coming to the anchor only halfway. ATM IV is +0.88 over the five sessions (10.57% -> 11.45%) and today broke the mid-window compression, so premium is no longer getting cheaper. The five-day read is a short-gamma book re-collateralising inside 960-1,100 with vol bottoming, and the newest money extending the call strip at 1,060/1,090/1,150 rather than paying for near-money puts.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1040/1000
strategies.rationale: The -4,472 cumulative GEX trough sits exactly at 1,040, so a break of that strike is dealer-amplified downward rather than faded - the Protection-zone playbook buys defined-risk downside with a long structure instead of selling into a pin that the GEX profile does not support.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit, about 9.5 points at mid (17.55 paid - 8.05 received); 40-point width caps max gain near 30.5 points.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1,080, the 25-delta call band, where the five-day call build (+471 OI) starts capping instead of the put side driving.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1060/1100
strategies.rationale: Short gamma all the way up the strip means a move through 1,060 gets chased, not dampened, and today's OI extension was call-side (+65 at 1,060, +64 at 1,090, +71 at 1,150) - this targets the 1,100 wall with the short leg parked on its 1,266 OI.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit, about 12.4 points at mid (18.80 paid - 6.40 received); 40-point width caps max gain near 27.6 points.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1,040, the GEX trough, which turns the amplification downward toward the 1,000 strike.

strategies.name: Long 1010/1080 strangle (25-delta bands)
strategies.rationale: With no gamma flip in the strip, direction is genuinely unresolved while 11.45% IV prices only a 7.59-point daily move - the matrix's short-gamma, direction-unclear cell, taken as a defined-risk premium outlay rather than any short-vol structure the negative GEX profile would punish.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = total premium paid, about 20.8 points at mid (9.50 + 11.25); breakevens 989.2 and 1,100.8, roughly -6.0% / +4.6%. 83 DTE makes theta and IV-crush the main drags - IV has already risen 0.88 points in five sessions.
strategies.invalidation: ATM IV falling back under 11.18%, the 2026-10-06 low, with price held inside 1,040-1,060 - that combination drains both legs at once.

S50Z26.prediction: 1,052.3 sits inside a 1,040-1,060 pocket where per-strike net GEX is near zero (-373, +324, +83) and the cumulative sum never flips, so the base case is a continued grind rather than a trend, with 7.59 points of daily 1-sigma keeping 1,040-1,060 the two-thirds-probability corridor. The short-gamma book means a move that clears 1,060 on expanding volume gets amplified toward the 1,080 call band instead of faded, and the shallow 1% max-pain bowl will not hold price at 1,050. Invalidation: a close below 1,040 - the -4,472 GEX trough - turns the amplification downward toward the 1,000 strike and voids the grind case.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no instruction to execute anything. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks: treat max pain 1,050 as a tendency, not a magnet - and here the pain curve is only 1% deep across 1,040-1,060, so even that tendency is faint. Defined-risk is not risk-free; the capped max loss on each structure above is a real outcome. Macro or policy flow can override the entire option structure, and with dealers short gamma at every strike from 960 to 1,150 such a move would be amplified rather than dampened.
